data.name: Enshrouded
data.short_description: Enshrouded is a solo and co-op survival action RPG where your freedom and creativity come first. Conquer the Shroud, a corrupting fog devouring the kingdom of Embervale: explore a handcrafted world full of secrets, forge your hero your way, and build anything, anywhere in a fully terraformable land.
data.about_the_game:
RISE AS A FLAMEBORN

You awaken as the last hope of a fallen kingdom. Forge your hero through a deep skill tree - armored juggernaut, deadly ranger, devastating battlemage - or blend them into a playstyle entirely your own.

EXPLORE A VAST WORLD OF WILD BEAUTY

Discover breathtaking landscapes and the secrets of a fallen civilization. Journey through lush forests, sun-scorched dunes, snow-capped peaks, and ruins swallowed by the Shroud. Swing across chasms with your grappling hook, glide from dizzying heights, and dive beneath the waters to reach places no road will ever lead to.

SURVIVE AND GROW

Live off the land - hunt, farm, fish, and scavenge rare materials. Rescue survivors from the Shroud, and your lonely hut grows into a bustling settlement of craftspeople and townsfolk, unlocking new recipes and gear. Survival here rewards preparation and creativity.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Thai

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 (2.7 GHz 4 Core) / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X (3.5 GHz 4 Core) or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (req. 6GB VRAM) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (req. 6GB VRAM) / Intel ARC A380
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Sound Card: on board
